name: daywatch/agent
description: Daywatch telemetry collector for Laravel apps — sensors observe framework events into a bounded buffer, digest over framed TCP to a local ReactPHP daemon, which batches and POSTs to the central Daywatch ingest.

suggest.ext-zlib: Enables gzip compression of the daemon's outbound ingest POSTs (Content-Encoding: gzip), as the wire contract expects. zlib ships enabled in virtually all PHP builds; it is only a soft suggestion so a host missing it can still install and run the package — the sensor/buffer/socket path never touches zlib. If gzencode() is unavailable the daemon drops each batch with a log line rather than fatalling (the package stays un-crashable), so telemetry upload simply pauses until the extension is present.
suggest.react/http: Not required and intentionally excluded: reactphp/http (every release, incl. 3.x-dev) hard-pins psr/http-message ^1.0, which downgrades/conflicts with a Laravel 13 host on psr/http-message ^2.0. The daywatch:agent daemon therefore POSTs batches over react/socket (raw HTTP/1.1), which carries no psr/http-message dependency.
